brand.name: Onyx
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full brand index. Founded 2000, named for its original dark, near-black Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper. Currently distributed/manufactured by Altadis USA, and has expanded from a single Dominican maduro line into a 3-line portfolio spanning Dominican and Nicaraguan-puro expressions. FLAG: the brand's pre-Altadis corporate origin (whether it launched under Consolidated Cigar Corp, Altadis's Dominican predecessor, or directly under Altadis USA) could not be confirmed.
brand.origin_country: Dominican Republic (Onyx Reserve); Nicaragua (Onyx Bold Nicaragua and Onyx Vintage Nicaragua)

line.name: Onyx Reserve
line.description: The original/legacy blend. Rich, medium-to-full-bodied maduro; several vitolas are square-pressed.

research_notes: Older retailer listings/reviews (e.g. a 2007 review) reference additional legacy vitolas not on the current official site (e.g. a 'No. 4') - treated as discontinued/unverified for the current catalog rather than added.
